title: Look-parity checklist scores Shadows ✅ while its own rubric and notes say 'not identical' (🟡)
evidence:
Scores: ✅ = matches the MM look,
🟡 = close but not identical, ❌ = misses.
--- axis 3 ---
| 3 | **Shadows** (soft blob shadows) | ✅ | Oversized low-alpha (14%) rounded blobs offset 2-3px under nodes — the flat-vector blob shadow. (A true radial-gradient softness is a slice-2 refinement.) |
--- verdict ---
the tilted-camera depth cue and a true radial-gradient shadow falloff are
deliberate slice-2 refinements (documented — the checklist is scored
honestly, not padded).
detail: The rubric defines 🟡 as 'close but not identical', the note concedes the shadow lacks MM's radial falloff, yet the score is ✅ — an internal inconsistency on the bake-off's PRIMARY criterion (look-parity ruling 2026-08-20).
recommended_fix: Score axis 3 🟡 (or define ✅ as 'matches at slice-1 fidelity' in the rubric header) so the comparison evidence stays honest.

title: bUseFixedFrameRate flipped to False while the repo contract (AGENTS.md) still says the pin is in DefaultEngine.ini
evidence:
bUseFixedFrameRate=False
FixedFrameRate=20.000000
--- the contract text the diff leaves standing ---
- **Fixed tick:** the sim steps at 20 Hz (ODN-2; `bUseFixedFrameRate` is
  pinned in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini`). `PP::Step` is the only sim advance.
--- and the new enforcement ---
+    check(ini_kv.get("/Script/Engine.Engine.bUseFixedFrameRate", "").lower() == "false",
+        "bUseFixedFrameRate must be False (UAD-2: the sim rate is the driver accumulator's; the render runs at display rate)")
detail: The r2 decision (sim rate via FPPSimDriver, render at display rate) is reasoned and documented in-code, but AGENTS.md — the binding agent contract every future round reads — still describes the opposite pin. Contract drift, not a code bug.
recommended_fix: Update the AGENTS.md fixed-tick clause to the r2 ruling (sim 20 Hz owned by FPPSimDriver; bUseFixedFrameRate=False documented) in this PR.
